faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) recruitment is 15-08-2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized board or university. Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi are also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 33 years as of 15-08-2026. Age relaxations are applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) post in this recruitment drive by GSSSB.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 49600 for the first 5 years, after which they will be placed in Pay Level-7, with a salary ranging from Rs. 39900 to Rs. 126600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 400/- for SC/ST and Women candidates. This fee is payable online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Computer Based Response Test (CBRT)/OMR followed by Document Verification. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for the post.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the GSSSB Additional Assistant Engineer (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official GSSSB website or the direct link provided. Ensure all required details and documents are uploaded correctly before the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. Women and candidates from reserved categories can avail up to 5 years of relaxation, and persons with disabilities (PwD) may get up to 10-15 years of relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
